verdict.rationale: The docs say you can connect your computer once so the dot can use your local files, code, and apps (dots-docs-10). They also say it can create local Work/Codex tasks and run builds with permitted local developer tools (dots-docs-19, dots-docs-25). Separately, the dot operates its own cloud computer and browser, and you can take over or return control (dots-docs-2, dots-docs-9). Missing for 10: details on how it sees and operates local GUI apps (screen viewing, input control, per-app permissions), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
